text:
anya: Quick sync — GA readiness prioritization for Launch X. I pulled top 6 customer asks from pilots. Need to decide must-have vs post-GA and SLA/pricing impact. Can we triage now? TL;DR propose these must-haves: 1) persistent KV cache, 2) per-tenant model pinning, 3) request-level audit logs. Other asks targeted post-GA. Thoughts?
kevin: Ack, running perf/cost numbers for KV cache now — will share sims in a bit.
sarah: +1 on audit logs as must-have for enterprise buyers, they'll walk away without it.
devon: Monitoring gap: we don't emit per-request latency histograms on cache hits today — big visibility hole for SLOs.
oliver: Pricing flag: model pinning increases capacity overhead (sticky allocations). We should pair pinning with a reserved/reserved-plus tier or per-model surcharge.
anya: Proposed SLA tiers:
``
- Standard: 99.9% uptime, no model pinning, basic docs
- Enterprise: 99.95% uptime, model pinning enabled, request-level audit logs, extended support
```
Agree?
kevin: Technical risk callout: model pinning adds scheduler complexity. ETA ~4w if we scope to simple pin-by-customer on dedicated pools; longer for per-model autoscaling.
sarah: Docs: I'll draft GA pages (what's included, examples, migration guide, FAQs). Need final feature list by Fri to freeze content.
devon: Oncall/runbooks: we need clear runbook for cache warmup, eviction storms, and fallback to uncached path. Also escalation for audit log failures.
anya: Owners — Kevin: runtime + cache; Sarah: docs + examples; Devon: monitoring + runbooks; Oliver: pricing scenarios. I'll own rollout decision & stakeholder signoff.
oliver: I'll prepare two pricing options: (A) per-model surcharge, (B) higher reserved tier delta. Will include revenue and churn sensitivity.
kevin: Quick perf note from sim: KV cache gives ~30% token-cost reduction on p99 for chat workloads and drops tail latency when warmed. Provides clear unit-econ win.
deploy-bot: Reminder: tag PRs with `ga-readiness`. CI lint failing on runtime/cache PR #2456.
sarah: Noted — I'll sync with Kevin's PR owner and clear the lint.
anya: Decision check — propose we defer two asks until post-GA: multi-region mirroring and per-token custom throttles. Need confirmation by EOD so docs can freeze.
kevin: OK to defer multi-region. Per-token throttles — if it's just simple rate limits it's doable v1, but fine to postpone to reduce scope.
devon: +1 postpone. We'll add telemetry spike checklist to prevent incidents during ramp.
anya: Next steps: owners update their sections in the GA tracker (<https://redwood.internal/ga-tracker|GA tracker>) by EOD. I'll book 30m tomorrow for final sign-off. :calendar: Any blockers?
